subtopics.title: The Cast of Symbols and the Four Equations

questions.question: The equations of motion may only be used when:
options: The object moves in a circle

questions.question: Which quantity is missing from the equation $v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2a\Delta x$?
The 'absent character' rule for choosing an equation says:
options: Pick the equation that excludes the quantity which is neither given nor wanted
Pick the equation with the most symbols
Pick the equation you remember best

subtopics.title: Choosing the Equation and Finding the Acceleration

questions.question: For the car problem (vi = 10 m/s, vf = 25 m/s, Δx = 300 m, find a), the absent quantity is:
options: Displacement — so use $v_f = v_i + a\Delta t$
Initial velocity — so use equation two

questions.question: Substituting into $v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2a\Delta x$ gives 625 = 100 + 600a. The acceleration is:
options: 0,875 m/s² in the direction of motion

questions.question: Why must the direction be stated with the acceleration answer?

subtopics.title: Finding the Time — Two Roads to One Answer

questions.question: Using $v_f = v_i + a\Delta t$ with a = 0,875 m/s², the time taken is:
The check via $\Delta x = \frac{(v_i + v_f)}{2}\Delta t$ uses the average velocity, which is:
Why is the second road (equation four) such a strong check on the first?
options: It uses only original given data, so an error in the calculated acceleration could not hide
It always gives a slightly different answer

subtopics.title: The Full Method, the Classic Traps, and Where This Leads

questions.question: A car travels at 90 km/h. Before using the equations of motion, this must become:
In $v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2a\Delta x$, a common error is:
options: Forgetting to square the velocities — writing 25 instead of 625

questions.question: If the car had been braking, the acceleration in your equations would be:
options: Negative (opposite to the chosen positive direction of motion)

questions.question: In Grade 12, these same equations reappear in vertical projectile motion, where the constant acceleration is:
options: Zero at the top of the flight
Different for heavy and light objects
